svg.text: 387 nodes · 535 relationships · 422 implied labels, generated from the EDM Council FIBO ontology at commit 33a92cd, entry modules FND/Law, FND/Agreements, FND/Parties and BE/LegalEntities, with their OMG Commons imports. The main arrows are named by their relationship type; hover any arrow for its name and description, and cards link to the term IRI.
Commons foundations and other support modules
required: every source has one or more
functional: every source has at most one
subtype: also carries the supertype's label

path.title: HAS_INTENDED_LIQUIDATION_DATE: Links an agreement, contract, or legal entity to a date on which it is scheduled to be sold. Every 'has intended liquidation date' of a SpecialPurposeVehicle is a Date.
HAS_INTENDED_LIQUIDATION_DATE: Links an agreement, contract, or legal entity to a date on which it is scheduled to be sold.
HAS_EFFECTIVE_DATE: Indicates the date a contract, relationship, or policy comes into force.
HAS_EXECUTION_DATE: Indicates the date a contract has been signed by all the necessary parties.
HAS_EXPIRATION_DATE: Links something, typically an agreement, contract, document, or perishable item, with an expiration date.
HAS_TERMINATION_DATE: Links something, typically an agreement, contract, document, or process, with a date on which it is scheduled to be or was terminated.
HAS_AS_OF_DATE: Relates something to the date on which it is accurate or valid (e.g. a credit report has an asOfDate that means the date when the information was drawn).
HAS_DATE_RECEIVED: Relates something to the date it arrived or was delivered, e.g., a loan application request.
IS_RELATIVE_TO: Identifies a specific date that a relative date or relative date period references.
HAS_EVENT_DATE: Identifies a date associated with an event (occurrence).
HAS_RELEASE_DATE: Specifies the date on which something is published.
HAS_DATE: Identifies a calendar day, month and year.
HAS_DATE_OF_ISSUANCE: Links something, such as an agreement, contract, license, or report, to the date it was made available. Each Thing has at most one Date.
HAS_END_DATE: Indicates the final or ending date associated with something.
HAS_START_DATE: Indicates the initial date associated with something.

HAS_AGE_OF_MAJORITY: Relates someone to the age required to attain the capacity to engage in certain transactions or be treated legally as an adult in some jurisdiction. Every 'has age of majority' of an Adult is an AgeOfMajority.
HAS_AGE_OF_MAJORITY: Relates someone to the age required to attain the capacity to engage in certain transactions or be treated legally as an adult in some jurisdiction.
HAS_CITIZENSHIP: Links a person to their country of citizenship. Every 'has citizenship' of a Person is a Country.
HAS_DATE_OF_BIRTH: Identifies the date on which an individual was born. Every Person has exactly one 'has date of birth' that is a DateOfBirth.
HAS_DATE_OF_DEATH: Identifies the date on which an individual died. Every 'has date of death' of a Person is a DateOfDeath.

HAS_MINIMUM_LEGAL_WORKING_AGE: Relates someone to the minimum legal working age for the jurisdiction in which they reside. Every 'has minimum legal working age' of a LegalWorkingAgePerson is a LegalWorkingAge.
HAS_MINIMUM_LEGAL_WORKING_AGE: Relates someone to the minimum legal working age for the jurisdiction in which they reside.
HAS_PLACE_OF_BIRTH: Identifies the location where an individual was born. Every Person has exactly one 'has place of birth' that is a PlaceOfBirth.
HAS_POINT_OF_CONTACT: Identifies a party designated as the point of contact for. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is point of contact for'.
HAS_PRIMARY_RESIDENCE: Identifies a dwelling where an individual resides the majority of the year.
HAS_RESIDENCE: Identifies a dwelling where an individual lives. Every 'has residence' of a Person is a ConventionalStreetAddress.
HAS_OBLIGATION: Identifies a duty or obligation that a given party has taken on. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is obligation of'. Every Obligor has one or more 'has obligation' that is a Commitment.

HAS_OBLIGATION: Identifies a duty or obligation that a given party has taken on. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is obligation of'. Every ContingentObligation has one or more 'is obligation of' that is an Obligor.
HAS_OBLIGATION: Identifies a duty or obligation that a given party has taken on. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is obligation of'.
DEFINES_TERMS_FOR: Relates a contract to something for which the contract defines legally binding terms and conditions.
HAS_BENEFICIARY: Party that receives some benefit or advantage or profits from something as specified in the agreement.
HAS_CONTRACT_DURATION: Indicates the period of time during which a contract is intended to be in force once it has been executed.

HAS_CONTRACT_PARTY: Indicates a party that has entered into a binding agreement, accepting and conceding obligations, responsibilities, and benefits as specified. Every Contract has two or more 'has contract party' that is a ContractParty.
HAS_CONTRACTUAL_ELEMENT: Indicates something that is a component of an agreement.
HAS_CONTRACTUAL_ELEMENT: Indicates something that is a component of an agreement. Every Contract has one or more 'has contractual element' that is a ContractualElement.
HAS_COUNTERPARTY: Identifies a party to a contract, typically not the contract principal.
HAS_COUNTERPARTY: Identifies a party to a contract, typically not the contract principal. Every WrittenContract has one or more 'has counterparty' that is a Counterparty.
HAS_EARLY_TERMINATION_DATE: Indicates a termination date that occurs prior to an explicit expiration date.
HAS_DATE_ADDED: Indicates the date something was included in something else.
HAS_FIXED_COMPARATIVE_DATE: Specifies the a specific date, such as the end of the last recession (e.g., March 2009) against which the scoped measure is compared.
HAS_EXPLICIT_DATE: Indicates a stated date, as opposed to a calculated or unknown date, associated with something.
HAS_EFFECTIVE_DATE: Indicates the date a contract, relationship, or policy comes into force. Every 'has effective date' of a Contract is a Date.
HAS_EFFECTIVE_DATE: Indicates the date a contract, relationship, or policy comes into force. Every 'has effective date' of a PowerOfAttorney is a Date.
HAS_EFFECTIVE_DATE_TIME_STAMP: Indicates the date and time, including time zone, something comes into force.
HAS_EXECUTION_DATE_TIME_STAMP: Indicates the date and time, including time zone, a contract has been signed by all the necessary parties.
HAS_DATE_TIME_STAMP: Identifies a specific date and time of day, explicitly including the time zone.
HAS_EFFECTIVE_DATE_TIME_STAMP: Indicates the date and time, including time zone, something comes into force. Every 'has effective date time stamp' of a WrittenContract is a DateTimeStamp.

HAS_EXECUTION_DATE_TIME_STAMP: Indicates the date and time, including time zone, a contract has been signed by all the necessary parties. Every 'has execution date time stamp' of a WrittenContract is a DateTimeStamp.
HAS_EXECUTION_DATE: Indicates the date a contract has been signed by all the necessary parties. Every 'has execution date' of a WrittenContract is a Date.
HAS_DATE_OF_ISSUANCE: Links something, such as an agreement, contract, license, or report, to the date it was made available. Every 'has date of issuance' of a WrittenContract is a Date.

HAS_EXTENDABLE_PERIOD: Indicates the window of time during which an extension is allowed under the terms of the contract. Every 'has extendable period' of an ExtensionProvision is an ExplicitDatePeriod.
HAS_EXTENSION_PROVISION: Specifies the details of a contract provision allowing extension of some aspect of the contract.
HAS_GOVERNING_JURISDICTION: Indicates the jurisdiction governing the contract, as agreed by all parties.
HAS_MILESTONE_PROVISION: Refers to a requirement included in an agreement related to fulfillment as of some point in time in the lifetime of the contract.
HAS_NON_BINDING_TERM: Refers to a term that is included in an agreement that is not considered legally binding.
HAS_NON_BINDING_TERM: Refers to a term that is included in an agreement that is not considered legally binding. Every TermSheet has one or more 'has non binding term' that is a NonBindingTerm.
HAS_PRINCIPAL_PARTY: Identifies the main or principal party to a contract.
HAS_PRINCIPAL_PARTY: Identifies the main or principal party to a contract. Every WrittenContract has one or more 'has principal party' that is a ContractPrincipal.
HAS_TERM: Indicates a fixed or limited period for which something, e.g., a contract, an investment, or an offer, lasts or is intended to last.
HAS_AGE: Relates something to the length of time it has existed.
HAS_DURATION: Specifies the time during which something continues.
HAS_THIRD_PARTY: Identifies a party which is not signatory to the party but has some role in the overall context defined by the contract.
IS_BENEFICIARY_OF: Specifies the agreement that a beneficiary is named in.
IS_EVIDENCE_FOR: Corroborates. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is evidenced by'. Every BirthCertificate has exactly one 'is evidence for' that is a PlaceOfBirth.
IS_EVIDENCE_FOR: Corroborates. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is evidenced by'. Every WrittenContract has one or more 'is evidenced by' that is a ContractDocument.
IS_EVIDENCE_FOR: Corroborates. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is evidenced by'. Every DeathCertificate has exactly one 'is evidence for' that is a DateOfDeath.
IS_EVIDENCE_FOR: Corroborates. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is evidenced by'. Every IdentityDocument has exactly one 'is evidence for' that is a DateOfBirth.
IS_EVIDENCE_FOR: Corroborates. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is evidenced by'. Every IdentityDocument has at most one 'is evidence for' that is a PhysicalAddress.
IS_EVIDENCE_FOR: Corroborates. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is evidenced by'. Every 'is evidence for' of an IdentityDocument is a PlaceOfBirth.
IS_EVIDENCE_FOR: Corroborates. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is evidenced by'.
QUALIFIES: Limits, constrains or refines. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is qualified by'.
IS_INPUT_TO: Indicates a precondition, requirement, or other contribution (e.g., data) to some activity, process, system, report, analysis, etc. FIBO also names the inverse, 'has input'.
IS_OUTPUT_FROM: Indicates post condition or other product of some activity, process, system, report, analysis, etc. FIBO also names the inverse, 'has output'.
ADDRESSES: Deals with, handles, or gives attention to. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is addressed by'.
IMPLEMENTS: Carries out or puts into effect, fulfills. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is implemented by'.
IMPLIES: Strongly suggests or involves as a logical consequence based on some set of observations, facts, or events. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is implied by'.

CAUSES: Relationship between an event or set of events or factors (the cause) and a second event, phenomenon, situation, or result (the effect), where the second event or outcome is understood as a consequence of the first. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is caused by'.
CONFERS: Grants or bestows by virtue of some authority. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is conferred by'.
CONTROLS: Exercises authority or influence over. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is controlled by'.
EMBODIES: Is an expression of, gives a tangible or visible form to (an idea, quality, or feeling), makes concrete and perceptible.
EVALUATES: Assesses the nature, quality, or ability of someone or something. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is evaluated by'.
EXCHANGES: Gives something in return something else.
EXEMPLIFIES: Is a concrete realization or example of. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is exemplified by'.
GENERATES: Produces through the application of one or more mathematical or logical steps or rules. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is generated by'.

HOLDS: Is the relationship between a party and something it possesses, or over which it exercises some ownership or control or has at its discretion the ability to dispose of it as it sees fit. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is held by'.
INVOLVES: (of a situation or event) includes (something) as a necessary part or result.
ISSUES: Officially makes something available. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is issued by'.
MANDATES: Relates something to a commitment, contract, law, obligation, requirement, regulation, or similar concept that requires it. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is mandated by'.
PRODUCES: Creates through a fabrication, manufacturing or production process. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is produced by'.
CHARACTERIZES: Provides a discriminating feature or quality of. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is characterized by'.
CLASSIFIES: Arranges in categories according to one or more shared characteristics. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is classified by'.
COMPRISES: Includes, consists of, or contains, especially within a particular scope. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is included in'.
HAS_CONSTITUENT: Consists of or contains. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is constituent of'.
HAS_DIRECT_PART: Indicates an immediate 'child' part of something. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is direct part of'.
HAS_MEMBER: Includes, as a discrete element. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is member of'.

HAS_PART: Indicates any portion of something, regardless of whether the portion itself is attached to the remainder or detached; cognitively salient or arbitrarily demarcated; self-connected or disconnected; homogeneous or gerrymandered; material or immaterial; extended or unextended; spatial or temporal. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is part of'. Transitive.
APPLIES_TO: Indicates something for which a context is material, germane, or relevant in some way. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is applicable in'.
USES: Employs to accomplish some task or achieve some result. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is used by'.
PRECEDES: Associates based on prior spatial or temporal proximity; occurs before in a logical order or sequence. FIBO also names the inverse, 'succeeds'.
DEFINES: Specifies the meaning of something in terms of one or more of its essential qualities. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is defined in'.
DESCRIBES: Conveys the nature of. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is described by'.
HAS_DATA_SOURCE: Relates something, such as an agreement, contract, document, record, report, or process, to a source of data used to analyze, develop, explain, produce, or otherwise create it.
IS_ABOUT: Indicates the subject or topic of something, such as a document.
RECORDS: Documents for later reference.
REFERS_TO: Makes reference to as a source for information or explanation. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is referred to by'.
SPECIFIES: Mentions, names or states something clearly and definitively. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is specified in'.
IS_PROVIDED_TO: Is made available to.
PROVIDES: Makes available. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is provided by'.
ACTS_ON: Relates an actor in a given situation to the undergoer that they affect under the circumstances. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is affected by'.
EXPERIENCES: Relates something to a situation that affects them in some way. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is experienced by'.
EXPERIENCES_DIRECTLY: Relates something directly to a party that drives a situation involving it. FIBO also names the inverse, 'plays active role that directly affects'.
EXPERIENCES_WITH: Relates something to an actor that drives a situation involving it. FIBO also names the inverse, 'directly affects'.
HAS_ACTIVE_PARTY: Relates a situation to the person or organization acting in a primary (agentive) role. FIBO also names the inverse, 'plays active party in'.
HAS_ACTIVE_ROLE: Relates a situation to something that is acting in a primary (agentive) role. FIBO also names the inverse, 'plays active role in'.
PLAYS_ACTIVE_ROLE_THAT_AFFECTS: Relates a person or organization to an undergoer they have an impact on under the circumstances. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is directly affected by'.
REALIZES: Relates something to a situation or constituency in which the role they play is secondary, such as an experiencer or passive participant. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is realized in'.
IS_DERIVED_FROM: Indicates something from which the subject is obtained or determined.
SPECIALIZES: Indicates something whose nature is more general (broader than) the subject.
GOVERNS: Has and exercises authority over. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is governed by'.
IS_APPLICABLE_IN_JURISDICTION: Indicates the geopolitical region identifier for the jurisdiction in which something is applicable.
ENABLES: Creates an environment or situation where something can occur or function efficiently. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is enabled by'.
IS_SITUATED_AT: Is placed at. FIBO also names the inverse, 'situates'.

IS_SUBORDINATE_TO: Indicates the primary contract referenced by a subordinate agreement, such as a collateral agreement. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is primary contract for'. Every CollateralAgreement has one or more 'is subordinate to' that is a WrittenContract.
IS_SUBORDINATE_TO: Indicates the primary contract referenced by a subordinate agreement, such as a collateral agreement. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is primary contract for'.
SUPERSEDES: Indicates a contract that was executed prior to and is replaced by this contract. Transitive.

HAS_EXPIRATION_DATE: Links something, typically an agreement, contract, document, or perishable item, with an expiration date. Every EarlyTerminationProvision has one or more 'has expiration date' that is an ExplicitDate.

HAS_EXPIRATION_DATE: Links something, typically an agreement, contract, document, or perishable item, with an expiration date. Every IdentityDocument has exactly one 'has expiration date' that is a Date.

HAS_DATE_OF_ISSUANCE: Links something, such as an agreement, contract, license, or report, to the date it was made available. Every IdentityDocument has exactly one 'has date of issuance' that is a Date.
HAS_RECORD: Links something to a record that pertains to it.
HAS_REPORTING_PERIOD: Specifies the reporting period for which a report or something else, such as a market rate or economic indicator, applies.
IS_INDEX_TO: That to which the index refers. Every Address has exactly one 'is index to' that is a Location.
IS_INDEX_TO: That to which the index refers. Every Index has exactly one 'is index to' that is a Thing.
IS_INDEX_TO: That to which the index refers. Every 'is index to' of a PhysicalAddress is a PhysicalLocation.
HAS_AGE: Relates something to the length of time it has existed. Every 'has age' of a Person is an Age.
HAS_ANCHOR_DATE: Specifies a fixed reference point within a series or timeline. Every 'has anchor date' of a QualifiedMeasure is an AnchorDate.
HAS_ANCHOR_DATE: Specifies a fixed reference point within a series or timeline. Every 'has anchor date' of a RegularSchedule is an AnchorDate.
HAS_ANCHOR_DATE: Specifies a fixed reference point within a series or timeline.

HAS_AS_OF_DATE: Relates something to the date on which it is accurate or valid (e.g. a credit report has an asOfDate that means the date when the information was drawn). Every Age has one or more 'has as of date' that is an ExplicitDate.

HAS_CALENDAR_PERIOD: Identifies a period of time used in computing a calendar-specified date, such as a calendar week, calendar month, calendar quarter, or calendar year. Every CalendarSpecifiedInterval has exactly one 'has calendar period' that is a CalendarPeriod.
HAS_CALENDAR_PERIOD: Identifies a period of time used in computing a calendar-specified date, such as a calendar week, calendar month, calendar quarter, or calendar year.
HAS_FINAL_STUB: Identifies any special period at the end of a regular schedule. Every 'has final stub' of a RegularSchedule is a ScheduleStub.
HAS_INITIAL_STUB: Identifies any special period at the start of a regular schedule. Every 'has initial stub' of a RegularSchedule is a ScheduleStub.
HAS_STUB: Links an abbreviated period at the start or end of some schedule to the overall schedule.
HAS_OVERALL_PERIOD: Identifies a date period that includes all the dates of a schedule, including any schedule stubs. Every Schedule has one or more 'has overall period' that is a DatePeriod.
HAS_RECURRENCE_INTERVAL: Indicates the frequency with which some event or publication occurs. Every RegularSchedule has one or more 'has recurrence interval' that is a RecurrenceInterval.
HAS_RECURRENCE_INTERVAL: Indicates the frequency with which some event or publication occurs.
HAS_PERIODICITY: Specifies a recurrence interval (monthly, quarterly, annual) that a statistical measure reflects.
HAS_REFERENCE_PERIOD: Specifies a reference (baseline) recurrence interval for which a given measure applies.
HAS_SCHEDULE: Indicates a schedule for something.

HAS_TIME_DIRECTION: Indicates whether a calendar-specified date is figured from the beginning or end of a calendar period. Every CalendarSpecifiedInterval has exactly one 'has time direction' that is a TimeDirection.
HAS_TIME_DIRECTION: Indicates whether a calendar-specified date is figured from the beginning or end of a calendar period.
IS_RELATIVE_TO: Identifies a specific date that a relative date or relative date period references. Every RelativeDate has exactly one 'is relative to' that is a Date.
HAS_OCCURRENCE: Identifies events of a given occurrence kind, typically as they occur in a schedule. Every 'has occurrence' of an AdHocScheduleEntry is an Occurrence.
HAS_OCCURRENCE: Identifies events of a given occurrence kind, typically as they occur in a schedule. Every 'has occurrence' of a RegularSchedule is an Occurrence.
HAS_OCCURRENCE: Identifies events of a given occurrence kind, typically as they occur in a schedule. Every 'has occurrence' of a ScheduleStub is an Occurrence.
HAS_OCCURRENCE: Identifies events of a given occurrence kind, typically as they occur in a schedule.

IS_INPUT_TO: Indicates a precondition, requirement, or other contribution (e.g., data) to some activity, process, system, report, analysis, etc. FIBO also names the inverse, 'has input'. Every 'has input' of a Project is a Thing.

IS_OUTPUT_FROM: Indicates post condition or other product of some activity, process, system, report, analysis, etc. FIBO also names the inverse, 'has output'. Every 'has output' of a Project is a Thing.
IS_TRIGGERED_BY: Is activated or initiated by. Every OccurrenceBasedDate has exactly one 'is triggered by' that is an OccurrenceKind.
ADDRESSES: Deals with, handles, or gives attention to. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is addressed by'. Every 'is addressed by' of an Aim is an Approach. Every 'addresses' of an Approach is an Aim.

HAS_OBJECTIVE: Aims to achieve within a time frame and with available resources. Every 'has objective' of a BusinessEntity is a BusinessObjective.

HAS_CAPACITY: Identifies an individual or organization that has some ability and availability to carry out certain actions, or has certain rights or obligations. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is capacity of'.
IMPLEMENTS: Carries out or puts into effect, fulfills. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is implemented by'. Every 'implements' of a Policy is one of LegalConstruct, Aim.
IMPLEMENTS: Carries out or puts into effect, fulfills. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is implemented by'. Every 'implements' of a Policy is one of LegalConstruct, Aim.

Every ContingentObligation has one or more 'is implied by' that is a ContingentRight. Every ContingentRight has one or more 'implies' that is a ContingentObligation.

IMPLIES: Strongly suggests or involves as a logical consequence based on some set of observations, facts, or events. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is implied by'. IS_CONFERRED_ON: Indicates a party to which some benefit or right has been granted. Every ContingentRight has one or more 'is conferred on' that is a Party.

HAS_PARTY: Identifies a party associated with an agreement, contract, policy, regulation, situation, or other arrangement. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is a party to'.
IS_PREDICATED_ON: Depends on an assumption or requirement stated in. Every ConditionPrecedent has a 'is predicated on' that is one of ContractualCommitment, ContractualObligation.
IS_PREDICATED_ON: Depends on an assumption or requirement stated in. Every ConditionPrecedent has a 'is predicated on' that is one of ContractualCommitment, ContractualObligation.

LICENSES: Issues a license required in order to perform some task, provide some service, exercise some privilege, or pursue some line of business or occupation to some party. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is licensed by'. Every Licensor has one or more 'licenses' that is a Thing.

LICENSES: Issues a license required in order to perform some task, provide some service, exercise some privilege, or pursue some line of business or occupation to some party. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is licensed by'.
MANAGES: Relates a party role to something or someone that it directs or administers in some way. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is managed by'.

HAS_IN_FORCE: Relates a jurisdiction or situation to a rule, regulation or law (collectively "law") that is currently in force in that situation or jurisdiction. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is in force in'. Every StatuteLaw has one or more 'is in force in' that is a Jurisdiction.

HAS_IN_FORCE: Relates a jurisdiction or situation to a rule, regulation or law (collectively "law") that is currently in force in that situation or jurisdiction. FIBO also names the inverse, 'is in force in'.
HAS_MAILING_ADDRESS: Identifies a physical address where an independent party can receive communications, including letters and packages. Every 'has mailing address' of a Party is a PhysicalAddress.

HAS_ADDRESS: Indicates a means by which something (in the case of a network address) or some entity may be located or contacted or may receive correspondence. Every 'has address' of a Party is a PhysicalAddress.
HAS_ADDRESS: Indicates a means by which something (in the case of a network address) or some entity may be located or contacted or may receive correspondence.
HAS_TRANSLITERATED_ADDRESS: Identifies a transliterated (i.e., in Latin or Romanized ASCII) address for the registered entity.

HAS_INDIVIDUAL_POSTCODE: Indicates the local or international postcode element of a delivery address as specified by the local postal service. Every PhysicalAddress has at most one 'has individual postcode' that is a Postcode.

HAS_POSTDIRECTIONAL_SYMBOL: Specifies a geographic directional symbol that follows the street name and street suffix in a street address. Every 'has postdirectional symbol' of a StreetAddress is a PostdirectionalSymbol.

HAS_PREDIRECTIONAL_SYMBOL: Specifies a geographic directional symbol that occurs after the primary street number but before the street name in a street address. Every 'has predirectional symbol' of a StreetAddress is a PredirectionalSymbol.
HAS_PRIMARY_ADDRESS_NUMBER: Specifies a a location with respect to a given street. Every StreetAddress has at most one 'has primary address number' that is a PrimaryAddressNumber.

HAS_SECONDARY_UNIT: Specifies an individual unit within a larger structure, such as an apartment, office, hangar, slip, mailbox, and so forth, at a given street address. Every 'has secondary unit' of a StreetAddress is a SecondaryUnit.

HAS_STREET_ADDRESS: Indicates a fully-specified address component that consists of a primary address number, predirectional, street name, suffix, postdirectional, and an optional secondary unit. Every ConventionalStreetAddress has at most one 'has street address' that is a StreetAddress.
HAS_STREET_NAME: Specifies an identifier for a street in some context (e.g., 'Baker', 'First', 'Main'). Every StreetAddress has one or more 'has street name' that is a StreetName.

HAS_STREET_SUFFIX: Specifies an additional qualifier for a street or other delivery location, such as a dwelling located along a waterway. Every 'has street suffix' of a StreetAddress is a StreetSuffix.
HAS_STRUCTURE_NAME: Specifies an identifier for a building, house, office complex, shopping center, or other structure or group of structures.

g.title: Thing — Anything at all: owl:Thing, which every class of the closure sits under. The label every node carries, and the end of the relationships FIBO and Commons leave open to any individual. Properties: uri
Actor — Primary performer in a relationship between parties, i.e., the party that does something, causes something to happen, or otherwise plays an agentive role in the relationship. Properties: uri
AdHocSchedule — Schedule consisting of some number of individual events that are not necessarily recurring. Properties: uri
AdHocScheduleEntry — Entry, including a date or date and time, among multiple non-regularly-recurring entries in a schedule. Properties: uri
Address — Index to a location to which communications may be delivered. Properties: uri
AddressComponent — Aspect of an address. Properties: uri
AddressingScheme — System for allocating addresses to objects. Properties: uri
Adult — Person who has attained the age of majority as defined in some jurisdiction. Properties: uri
Age — Length of time that something or someone has been alive or existed. Properties: uri
AgeOfMajority — Age at which someone acquires the rights and responsibilities of an adult in some jurisdiction. Properties: uri
Agent — Something autonomous that can adapt to and interact with its environment. Properties: uri
AgentRole — Role played by any agent. Properties: uri
Agreement — Negotiated understanding between two or more parties, reflecting the offer and acceptance of commitments on the part of either party. Properties: uri
Aim — Intention specifying a desired direction, condition, or situation toward which an agent's actions are directed, without requiring precise scope or measurable criteria. Properties: uri
AnchorDate — Fixed reference point within a series or timeline. Properties: uri
AnnualizedStandardDeviation — Standard deviation for some measure over a specific reference period. Properties: uri
Approach — Way of addressing an aim or problem characterized by high-level planning and systematic execution, without presupposing scope or granularity. Properties: uri
ArbitraryUnit — Arbitrarily defined unit of measurement, where a relation of the unit to a physical unit of the SI does not exist or is unknown. Properties: uri
ArithmeticMean — Sum of a collection of numbers divided by the number of numbers in the collection. Properties: uri
Arrangement — Systematic plan, manner, or method for making, doing, achieving, or organizing something. Properties: uri, hasMethod
Aspect — Characteristic or feature that can be used to dimensionalize, filter, or subset a class, collection, or set of things. Properties: uri
AssignableContract — Contract in which contract holder (assignor) may transfer some or all of their rights and obligations to another party (assignee). Properties: uri
Authorization — Situation in which a party authorizes someone to act on their behalf or to have specific capabilities under certain conditions for some period of time. Properties: uri
AuthorizedParty — Party that has been given the ability to act on behalf of another party or to have specified capabilities under some set of guidelines for some period of time. Properties: uri
AuthorizingParty — Party that delegates some role, authority, or control to another party. Properties: uri
AverageAbsoluteDeviation — Average of the absolute deviations from a central point. Properties: uri

BaseQuantityKind — Quantity in a conventionally chosen subset of a given system of quantities, where no quantity in the subset can be expressed in terms of the other quantities within that subset. Properties: uri
BaseUnit — Measurement unit that is defined by a system of units to be the reference measurement unit for a base quantity. Properties: uri
Beneficiary — Party that receives some benefit or advantage or profits from something. Properties: uri
BilateralAgreement — Agreement where two parties commit to perform specific actions or obligations towards each other. Properties: uri
BilateralContract — Contract where two parties commit to perform specific actions or obligations towards each other. Properties: uri
BilateralNettingProvision — Netting provision that occurs between two parties, in which mutual obligations are offset to determine a single net payment. Properties: uri
BirthCertificate — An original document certifying the circumstances of the birth, or a certified copy of or representation of the ensuing registration of that birth. Properties: uri
BirthCertificateIdentificationScheme — System for allocating identifiers to birth certificates. Properties: uri
BirthCertificateIdentifier — Identifier associated with a vital record documenting the birth of a child. Properties: uri
BreachOfContract — Classifier of events representing a violation of an express, or implied, condition of a contract to do or not to do something, without a legitimate excuse. Properties: uri
BreachOfCovenant — Classifier of events representing breaking a promise specified in a contract to do or not to do something, without a legitimate excuse. Properties: uri
BusinessCalendar — Schedule and communications tool used to manage meetings, plan events, and coordinate activities within and/or across organizations. Properties: uri
BusinessCenter — Municipality where business is conducted, especially one that is considered a financial center. Properties: uri
BusinessEntity — Entity that is formed and administered as per commercial law in order to engage in business activities. Properties: uri
BusinessLicense — License that allows the holder to conduct business or carry out a specific profession within some jurisdiction for some period of time. Properties: uri
BusinessObjective — Objective that reflects the strategic goals and direction of a business within a time frame and available resources. Properties: uri
BusinessStrategy — Strategy for achieving a specific business goal, objective, solution or outcome. Properties: uri
CalculatedDate — Date that is or will be determined based on some formula. Properties: uri
Calculation — Actual execution of some computation, computational process, or operation that was scheduled or triggered by something. Properties: uri
CalculationEvent — Kind of event that is either scheduled or triggered by something, such as a related financial event, that causes a calculation to be performed. Properties: uri
CalculationPeriod — Explicit period from the start to the end of a specific interval or range within which a computational process or operation occurs. Properties: uri

CalculationPeriodLength — Explicit number of days from the adjusted effective or start date to the adjusted termination or end date calculated in accordance with the applicable day count fraction. Properties: uri
CalendarPeriod — Time interval that occurs within a system that fixes the beginning and length of a segment of the year with respect to that system. Properties: uri

CalendarSpecifiedInterval — Recurrence interval that is defined as the nth day of some calendar period (such as a calendar month), and a time direction (forward from the beginning of the month, or backwards from the end). Properties: uri, hasOrdinalNumber
Capability — Ability to perform a specific function or achieve a particular outcome. Properties: uri
Capacity — Maximum extent to which something or someone can perform a function or produce an output under specified conditions. Properties: uri
Certificate — Document attesting to the truth of some fact or set of facts. Properties: uri
CharteredLegalPerson — A legal person created by a royal charter or decree. Properties: uri
Claim — Demand or assertion made by one party on another, based on facts that, taken together, give rise to a legally enforceable right or judicial action. Properties: uri
ClassificationScheme — System for allocating classifiers to things. Properties: uri, isExclusive
Classifier — Standardized classification or delineation for something, per some scheme for such delineation, within a specified context. Properties: uri
CloseOutNettingProvision — Netting provision that may be triggered when a counterparty defaults, leading to the termination of all outstanding transactions between the parties. Properties: uri
CodeElement — Sequence of characters denoting something for some purpose, within a specified context, according to some rule set. Properties: uri
CodeSet — System of alpha-numeric symbols, or combinations of symbols, that stand for specified values in some context. Properties: uri

CoherentDerivedUnit — Derived unit that, for a given system of quantities and for a chosen set of base units, is a product of powers of base units with no other proportionality factor than one. Properties: uri

CollateralAgreement — Written contract related to another contract designed to provide clarity and additional protection for all parties involved, that is separate from the primary contract and that can be independently enforced. Properties: uri
Collection — Grouping of things (may be zero) that have some shared significance. Properties: uri
Commitment — Promise made by some party to act or refrain from acting in some manner. Properties: uri
CommitmentAtLarge — Commitment made by some party without direct involvement from the potential beneficiaries of that commitment. Properties: uri
Composition — Distinct thing resulting from bringing together other things, possibly in specific roles, for a particular purpose. Properties: uri
ConditionPrecedent — Stipulation that specifies conditions that must be met before some aspect of a contract takes effect. Properties: uri
Constant — Symbol that represents a value that does not change (i.e., is fixed) with respect to a formula or expression. Properties: uri
Constituent — Component of a collection or combination of things. Properties: uri
Constitution — Set of basic principles by which an organization is governed, especially in relation to the rights of the people it governs. Properties: uri
Contact — Role or associated with a party serving as a designated point of communication, typically within a system or process. Properties: uri
ContactRecord — Record about a party in a specific communicative or liaison role. Properties: uri
Context — Situation or frame of reference in which something applies, exists, happens, or is used and that helps to illustrate or explain it. Properties: uri
ContextualDesignation — Designation that applies to something in some context. Properties: uri
ContextualIdentificationScheme — Identification scheme that applies within one or more contexts. Properties: uri
ContextualIdentifier — Sequence of characters uniquely identifying that with which it is associated, within a specified context. Properties: uri
ContextualName — Designation by which someone, some place, or something is known in some context. Properties: uri
ContingentObligation — Obligation that depends on a future event or the performance of an action. Properties: uri
ContingentRight — Right that depends on a future event or the performance of an action. Properties: uri

Contract — Voluntary, deliberate agreement between competent parties to which the parties agree to be legally bound, and for which the parties provide valuable consideration. Properties: uri, isAssignable
ContractDocument — Legal document that records the formal terms and conditions of some contract. Properties: uri

ContractMilestone — Classifier for an event (milestone), or set of events related to the status or level of completion of a designated activity, task, or segment of work required for contract fulfillment. Properties: uri
ContractParty — Legally competent party that has entered into a binding agreement, accepting and conceding obligations, responsibilities, and benefits as specified. Properties: uri
ContractPrincipal — Party that originates a contract and is identified as the first party to that contract, in the event that the contract distinguishes any party as such. Properties: uri
ContractThirdParty — Party that is indirectly involved in, but not a counterparty to, an agreement. Properties: uri
ContractualCapability — The capacity to enter into legally binding contracts. Properties: uri

ContractualCommitment — Provision specifying something that the contracting parties agree to, i.e., a promise or pledge made by one of the parties to perform some action or fulfill some duty. Properties: uri

ContractualDefinition — Contractual element that specifies the meaning of a term in a legal document, whose definition is substitutable for the term whenever it occurs in the body of that document. Properties: uri
ContractualElement — Element, such as an arrangement, provision, requirement, rule, specification, and standard that forms an integral part of an agreement. Properties: uri, hasLegalDescription

ContractualInterest — Legally enforceable benefit or entitlement arising from a contract, agreement, or instrument, in which an entity holds specified rights or obligations related to the performance, use, or benefit of something, without necessarily holding ownership. Properties: uri, hasFractionalInterest
ContractualObligation — Legally binding obligation that arises from the terms of a contract. Properties: uri

ContractualOption — Contractual right that may be exercised at some point in the future, such as an option to extend a contract, or other available but not obligatory rights as defined in the contract. Properties: uri
ContractualRight — Legally enforceable benefit or entitlement granted to a party within a binding agreement. Properties: uri
ConventionalStreetAddress — Physical address that identifies a location on a street to which communications may be delivered. Properties: uri, hasAddressLine1, hasAddressLine2, hasAddressLine3
ConversionBasedUnit — Derived unit that is defined with respect to another reference unit through an explicit conversion relationship. Properties: uri
ConversionFactorBetweenUnits — Ratio of two measurement units for quantities of the same kind. Properties: uri
Counterparty — Party to a contract with whom one negotiates on a given agreement. Properties: uri
Country — Geopolitical entity representing a distinct territorial body or political entity or dependent territory. Properties: uri, isIndependent

CountrySubdivision — Geopolitical entity that is a legal division of a country, dependency, or other area of special geopolitical interest related to a country or other geopolitical entity. Properties: uri
County — Political and administrative division of a country, state or province, providing certain local governmental services. Properties: uri
CourtOfLaw — Person or body of persons having judicial authority to hear and resolve disputes on the basis of statutes or the common law. Properties: uri
CyclicRatioScale — Measurement scale that represents a ratio scale with a periodic cycle. Properties: uri
Date — Calendar day on some calendar. Properties: uri, hasDateValue
DateOfBirth — Explicit date, i.e., the day, month and year, on which an individual was born. Properties: uri
DateOfDeath — Explicit date, i.e., the day, month and year, on which an individual died. Properties: uri
DatePeriod — Time span over one or more calendar days. Properties: uri
DateTime — Time point including a date and a time, optionally including a time zone offset. Properties: uri, hasDateTimeValue
DateTimeStamp — Time point including a date and a time that requires a time zone offset. Properties: uri, hasDateTimeStampValue
DatedCollectionConstituent — Element of a collection that is associated with a date and time. Properties: uri, hasObservedDateTime
DatedStructuredCollection — Structured collection whose elements are required to have a date and time. Properties: uri

DeathCertificate — Original document certifying the circumstances of the death (such as how and when it occurred), or a certified copy of or representation of the ensuing registration of that death. Properties: uri
DeathCertificateIdentificationScheme — System for allocating identifiers to death certificates. Properties: uri
DeathCertificateIdentifier — Identifier associated with a vital record documenting the death of an individual. Properties: uri

DelegatedLegalAuthority — Institutionalized and legal power inherent in a particular job, function, or position that is meant to enable its holder to successfully carry out his or her responsibilities, where such power has been delegated through some formal means. Properties: uri
DeliveryObligation — Obligation to deliver something in order to satisfy a claim or debt. Properties: uri
DerivedQuantityKind — Quantity, in a system of quantities, defined in terms of the base quantities of that system. Properties: uri

DerivedUnit — Measurement unit for a derived quantity, i.e., one that is defined with respect to one or more base units, such as as a product of powers of one or more other measurement units. Properties: uri
Designation — Representation for something, or for a conceptualization thereof, that denotes it in a domain or subject. Properties: uri, hasTextValue
Difference — Quantity by which amounts differ; the remainder left after subtraction of one value from another. Properties: uri
DimensionlessQuantity — Quantity for which all the exponents of the factors corresponding to the base quantities in its quantity dimension are zero. Properties: uri
DisclosureProvision — Contractual provision that outlines the requirements and responsibilities of one or both parties to reveal certain information to each other. Properties: uri
Dispersion — Degree of scatter or variability shown by observations. Properties: uri, hasCollectionSize
DistributionStrategy — Strategy for making a product or service available, or for distributing funds, such as in the form of a dividend or coupon. Properties: uri
Document — Unitary expression of some realization of an intellectual or artistic work. Properties: uri
DocumentPart — Structurally distinct subdivision of a document. Properties: uri

DriversLicense — An official document which states that a person may operate a motorized vehicle, such as a motorcycle, car, truck or a bus, on a public roadway or provides official identifying information for a non-driver. Properties: uri
DriversLicenseIdentificationScheme — System for allocating identifiers to driver's, operating, or non-driver identification documents. Properties: uri
DriversLicenseIdentifier — Identifier associated with a drivers' or operating license for operating a motor vehicle or non-driver identification card. Properties: uri
Duration — Interval of time of some specific length. Properties: uri, hasDurationValue
Duty — Some obligation which exists and is imposed on some individual. Properties: uri
EarlyTerminationProvision — Termination of an agreement for any reason prior to its expiration date. Properties: uri
EmancipatedMinor — A minor who is allowed to conduct a business or any other occupation on his or her own behalf or for their own account outside the control of a parent or guardian. Properties: uri
ExplicitDate — Date in which the 'has date value' property is required. Properties: uri, hasDateValue
ExplicitDatePeriod — Date period for which the start date, end date, and/or duration are required. Properties: uri
ExplicitDuration — Duration for which the 'has duration value' property must have a value. Properties: uri, hasDurationValue
ExplicitRecurrenceInterval — Recurrence interval defined via an explicit duration. Properties: uri, hasDurationValue
ExplicitTimePeriod — Time period for which the starting time, ending time, and/or duration are required. Properties: uri
Expression — Finite combination of symbols that are well-formed according to applicable rules. Properties: uri
ExtensionProvision — Contract terms that specify the conditions under which a contract can be extended. Properties: uri
